This check is\nindependent of, and in addition to, the per-input checkpoint hashes and the\nfinal-state hash carried in `trace.replay`: a `trace.initialState` that has\nbeen altered in any field — including fields with no dedicated schema rule, e.g. `cash` — while keeping the same overall shape must still be rejected,\nbecause it no longer matches what this engine's own seed actually produces at\ntick 0, even though every individual field still parses.\n\nThe only initial-state divergence `replayArenaTrace` must tolerate is the\nlegacy `expediter` role/worker id in place of `supply_lead`: canonicalize\nworker `role`/`id` on both the freshly constructed engine's initial state and\n`trace.initialState` (mapping `expediter`/`worker-expediter` to\n`supply_lead`/`worker-supply_lead`) before hashing and comparing them, so a\nhistorical trace naming the legacy roster still passes this check and then\nreplays and reaches the identical terminal record (status, tick, and reason);\nonly the role name is legacy, not the worker's real behavior or the outcome\nit produces.\n\nIt must throw if any checkpoint or state hash recorded in `trace.replay`\ndisagrees with what native replay actually produces, or if the recorded\n`trace.terminal` disagrees with the terminal record native replay itself\nreaches. = e;\n      e = (d + temp1) >>> 0;\n      d = c;\n      c = b;\n      b = a;\n      a = (temp1 + temp2) >>> 0;\n    }\n\n    h0 = (h0 + a) >>> 0;\n    h1 = (h1 + b) >>> 0;\n    h2 = (h2 + c) >>> 0;\n    h3 = (h3 + d) >>> 0;\n    h4 = (h4 + e) >>> 0;\n    h5 = (h5 + f) >>> 0;\n    h6 = (h6 + g) >>> 0;\n    h7 = (h7 + h) >>> 0;\n  }\n\n  const hex = [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7]\n    .map((v) => (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, \"0\"))\n    .join(\"\");\n  return `sha256:${hex}`;\n}\n\nconst FLOAT_FIELDS = new Set([\n  \"cash\", \"coordination\", \"correctionUptake\", \"load\", \"reading\",\n  \"reputation\", \"safetyThreshold\", \"satisfaction\", \"waitTime\", \"waste\",\n]);\n\nfunction serializeJson(value: unknown, pretty: boolean, sortKeys: boolean, level = 0, key?: string): string | undefined {\n  if (value === undefined) return undefined;\n  if (value === null || typeof value === \"boolean\" || typeof value === \"string\") return JSON.stringify(value);\n  if (typeof value === \"number\") {\n    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw new TypeError(\"canonical JSON does not support non-finite numbers\");\n    return FLOAT_FIELDS.has(key ?? \"\") && Number.isInteger(value) ? `${value}.0` : JSON.stringify(value);\n  }\n  if (Array.isArray(value)) {\n    const items = value.map((item) => serializeJson(item, pretty, sortKeys, level + 1));\n    return pretty && items.length > 0\n      ? `[\\n${items.map((item) => `${\"  \".repeat(level + 1)}${item ?? \"null\"}`).join(\",\\n\")}\\n${\"  \".repeat(level)}]`\n      : `[${items.map((item) => item ?? \"null\").join(\",\")}]`;\n  }\n  if (typeof value === \"object\") {\n    const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;\n    const keys = Object.keys(record);\n    if (sortKeys) keys.sort();\n    const entries = keys.flatMap((entryKey) => {\n      const serialized = serializeJson(record[entryKey], pretty, sortKeys, level + 1, entryKey);\n      return serialized === undefined ? [] : [[entryKey, serialized] as const];\n    });\n    return pretty && entries.length > 0\n      ? `{\\n${entries.map(([entryKey, serialized]) => `${\"  \".repeat(level + 1)}${JSON.stringify(entryKey)}: ${serialized}`).join(\",\\n\")}\\n${\"  \".repeat(level)}}`\n      : `{${entries.map(([entryKey, serialized]) => `${JSON.stringify(entryKey)}:${serialized}`).join(\",\")}}`;\n  }\n  throw new TypeError(`Unsupported JSON value: ${typeof value}`);\n}\n\n/** Backend-compatible JSON: sorted keys and decimal spelling for float fields. */\nexport function canonicalJson(value: unknown): string {\n  return serializeJson(value, false, true) ?? \"null\";\n}\n\nexport function computeStateHash(data: unknown): string {\n  const json = typeof data === \"string\" ? data : canonicalJson(data);\n  return sha256Bytes(new TextEncoder().encode(json));\n}\n\n// ── Capture ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport interface TraceCaptureOptions {\n  episodeId?: string;\n  sessionId?: string;\n  /** Required: live gameplay, synthetic episodes and benchmark episodes must stay distinguishable. */\n  runKind: \"live\" | \"synthetic\" | \"benchmark\";\n  envVersion?: string;\n  /**\n   * Re-bases every captured event timestamp onto this instant, one\n   * `MS_PER_TICK` step per tick. Each one is\n   * stamped with the round its `tick` falls in, so a caller cannot introduce\n   * an event the reviewer cannot line up against the round it belongs to.\n   */\n  additionalEvents?: TraceV3Event[];\n}\n\nconst RUN_KINDS: readonly TraceCaptureOptions[\"runKind\"][] = [\"live\", \"synthetic\", \"benchmark\"];\n\nfunction episodeIdFor(initialState: Record<string, unknown>, variation: string, seed: number): string {\n  const episode = initialState.episode as { id?: unknown } | undefined;\n  return typeof episode?.id === \"string\" && episode.id ? episode.id : `${variation}-${seed}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Capture a complete, replayable `restaurant-arena-trace/v3` record from a\n * running game: its tick-0 state, its event journal, and the ordered inputs\n * plus checkpoint hashes `replayArenaTrace` re-derives.\n *\n * `RestaurantGame.captureTrace` is a thin wrapper around this, so a caller that\n * holds a game and one that only holds a module import get the same record.\n */\nexport function captureArenaTrace(game: RestaurantGame, options: TraceCaptureOptions): RestaurantArenaTraceV3 {\n  if (typeof options !== \"object\" || options === null) {\n    throw new TypeError(\"captureArenaTrace requires an options object naming a runKind\");\n  }\n  if (!RUN_KINDS.includes(options.runKind)) {\n    throw new TypeError(\n      `captureArenaTrace requires runKind of ${RUN_KINDS.map((kind) => `\"${kind}\"`).join(\", \")}; received ${JSON.stringify(options.runKind)}`,\n    );\n  }\n\n  const initialState = game.getInitialState();\n  const replay = game.getReplayRecord();\n  const seed = typeof initialState.seed === \"number\" ? initialState.seed : game.state().seed;\n  const ticksPerRound = game.contract().ticksPerRound;\n\n  const journal = rebaseTimestamps(options.events ?? game.getRecordedEvents(), options.startTime);\n  const additional = (options.additionalEvents ?? ARENA_ENV_VERSION,\n    contractVersion: TRACE_V3_CONTRACT_VERSION,\n    runKind: options.runKind,\n    initialState,\n    events: mergeEventsByTick(journal, additional),\n    replay,\n    terminal: game.getTerminalStatus(),\n    deletion: {\n      requestId: options.deletion?.requestId ?? null,\n      status: options.deletion?.status ?? \"retained\",\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction rebaseTimestamps(events: readonly TraceV3Event[], startTime?: string): TraceV3Event[] {\n  if (startTime === undefined) return events.map((event) => ({ ...event }));\n  const base = Date.parse(startTime);\n  if (!Number.isFinite(base)) throw new TypeError(`captureArenaTrace startTime is not a date: ${JSON.stringify(startTime)}`);\n  return events.map((event) => ({\n    ...event,\n    timestamp: new Date(base + event.tick * MS_PER_TICK).toISOString(),\n  }));\n}\n\n/**\n * Caller-supplied events land in tick order among the game's own, so the\n * journal a reviewer reads is still chronological. Stable within a tick: the\n * run's own events come first.\n */\nfunction mergeEventsByTick(journal: TraceV3Event[], additional: TraceV3Event[]): TraceV3Event[] {\n  if (additional.length === 0) return journal;\n  return [\n    ...journal.map((event) => ({ event, source: 0 })),\n    ...additional.map((event) => ({ event, source: 1 })),\n  ]\n    .sort((a, b) => a.event.tick - b.event.tick || a.source - b.source)\n    .map(({ event }) => event);\n}\n\n// ── Export ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/** The whole record as one pretty-printed JSON document. */\nexport function exportTraceJson(trace: RestaurantArenaTraceV3): string {\n  return `${JSON.stringify(trace, null, 2)}\\n`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Newline-delimited streaming form: a header line carrying everything but the\n * journal, then one line per event. ...events.map((event) => JSON.stringify(event))].join(\"\\n\")}\\n`;\n}\n\n// ── Validation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport interface TraceValidationResult {\n Only the name is legacy, not the behavior. */\nconst LEGACY_ROLE = \"expediter\";\nconst LEGACY_WORKER_ID = \"worker-expediter\";\nconst CANONICAL_ROLE = \"supply_lead\";\nconst CANONICAL_WORKER_ID = \"worker-supply_lead\";\n\n/**\n * The tick-0 state as both sides can agree to spell it.\n *\n * Historical traces name the `expediter` worker where this engine now names\n * `supply_lead`, and listed the roster in a different order. Both are the same\n * worker doing the same job, so the role/id pair is mapped and the roster put\n * in a fixed order before hashing. Nothing else is touched: every other field —\n * `cash` included — has to match what the seed actually produces.\n */\nfunction canonicalInitialState(state: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {\n  const canonical = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(state)) as Record<string, unknown>;\n  if (!Array.isArray(canonical.workers)) return canonical;\n  canonical.workers = (canonical.workers as Array<Record<string, unknown>>)\n    .map((worker) => ({\n      ...worker,\n      ...(worker.id === LEGACY_WORKER_ID ? { id: CANONICAL_WORKER_ID } : {}),\n      ...(worker.role === LEGACY_ROLE ? { role: CANONICAL_ROLE } : {}),\n    }))\n    .sort((a, b) => sortKey(a).localeCompare(sortKey(b)));\n  return canonical;\n}\n\nfunction sortKey(worker: Record<string, unknown>): string {\n  return `${String(worker.role ?? \"\")}\u0000${String(worker.id ?? \"\")}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Apply one recorded input to a live game and verify the checkpoint it lands\n * on. Throws on the first hash that disagrees, naming the input's position so\n * the divergence can be found in the record.\n */\nexport function applyArenaReplayInput(game: RestaurantGame, input: ArenaInputRecord, index: number): void {\n  switch (input.kind) {\n    case \"step\":\n      game.step(input.action as RestaurantGameAction);\n      break;\n    case \"time\":\n      game.advanceTime();\n      break;\n    case \"envelope\":\n      game.stepEnvelope(input.envelope, input.telemetry);\n      break;\n    case \"controllers\":\n      game.setExternalControllers(input.roles as Role[]);\n      break;\n    default:\n      throw new Error(`replay input ${index} has unknown kind ${JSON.stringify((input as { kind: unknown }).kind)}`);\n  }\n\n  const stateHash = computeStateHash(game.checkpointState());\n  if (stateHash !== input.stateHash) {\n    throw new Error(\n      `replay checkpoint mismatch at input ${index} (${input.kind}, tick ${input.tick}): recorded ${input.stateHash}, replayed ${stateHash}`,\n    );\n  }\n  if (input.restaurantStateHash !== undefined) {\n    const restaurantStateHash = computeStateHash(game.state());\n    if (restaurantStateHash !== input.restaurantStateHash) {\n      throw new Error(\n        `replay state mismatch at input ${index} (${input.kind}, tick ${input.tick}): recorded ${input.restaurantStateHash}, replayed ${restaurantStateHash}`,\n      );\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Rebuild the live game a trace records and hand it back.\n *\n * The returned value is the `RestaurantGame` itself, so a caller can go on to\n * ask it anything a live game answers — `.checkpointState()`, `.state()`,\n * `.getTerminalStatus()`.\n *\n * Replay starts from a freshly constructed game for the recorded seed and\n * variation, never from `trace.initialState` taken on faith: the recorded\n * tick-0 state is checked against what this engine's own seed produces before\n * a single input is applied. Then every checkpoint hash, the final state hash,\n * and the whole terminal record — status, tick and reason — must agree with\n * what replay actually reaches.\n */\nexport function replayArenaTrace(trace: RestaurantArenaTraceV3): RestaurantGame {\n  const game = new RestaurantGame(trace.seed, trace.replay.variation);\n\n  const recordedInitialHash = computeStateHash(canonicalInitialState(trace.initialState));\n  const replayedInitialHash = computeStateHash(canonicalInitialState(game.getInitialState()));\n  if (recordedInitialHash !== replayedInitialHash) {\n    throw new Error(\n      `initial state mismatch for seed ${trace.seed} (${trace.replay.variation}): recorded ${recordedInitialHash}, replayed ${replayedInitialHash}`,\n    );\n  }\n\n  trace.replay.inputs.forEach((input, index) => applyArenaReplayInput(game, input, index));\n\n  const finalStateHash = computeStateHash(game.checkpointState());\n  if (finalStateHash !== trace.replay.finalStateHash) {\n    throw new Error(\n      `replay final state mismatch: recorded ${trace.replay.finalStateHash}, replayed ${finalStateHash}`,\n    );\n  }\n  if (trace.replay.finalRestaurantStateHash !== undefined) {\n    const finalRestaurantStateHash = computeStateHash(game.state());\n    if (finalRestaurantStateHash !== trace.replay.finalRestaurantStateHash) {\n      throw new Error(\n        `replay final restaurant state mismatch: recorded ${trace.replay.finalRestaurantStateHash}, replayed ${finalRestaurantStateHash}`,\n      );\n    }\n  }\n\n  // The whole terminal record, not just the status: a trace whose reason has\n  // been rewritten is as untrue as one whose status has.\n  const terminal = game.getTerminalStatus();\n  const recorded = trace.terminal;\n  if (\n    terminal.status !== recorded?.status ||\n    terminal.tick !== recorded.tick ||\n    (terminal.reason ?? null) !== (recorded.reason ?? null)\n  ) {\n    throw new Error(\n      `terminal mismatch: recorded ${JSON.stringify(recorded)}, replayed ${JSON.stringify(terminal)}`,\n    );\n  }\n\n  return game;\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":35,"oldLines":7,"newStart":35,"newLines":7,"lines":["       ...(worker.id === LEGACY_WORKER_ID ?
