  h3 = (h3 + d) >>> 0;\n    h4 = (h4 + e) >>> 0;\n    h5 = (h5 + f) >>> 0;\n    h6 = (h6 + g) >>> 0;\n    h7 = (h7 + h) >>> 0;\n  }\n\n  const hex = [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7]\n    .map((v) => (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, \"0\"))\n    .join(\"\");\n  return `sha256:${hex}`;\n}\n\nconst FLOAT_FIELDS = new Set([\n  \"cash\", \"coordination\", \"correctionUptake\", \"load\", \"reading\",\n  \"reputation\", \"safetyThreshold\", \"satisfaction\", \"waitTime\", \"waste\",\n]);\n\nfunction serializeJson(value: unknown, pretty: boolean, sortKeys: boolean, level = 0, key?: string): string | undefined {\n  if (value === undefined) return undefined;\n  if (value === null || typeof value === \"boolean\" || typeof value === \"string\") return JSON.stringify(value);\n  if (typeof value === \"number\") {\n    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw new TypeError(\"canonical JSON does not support non-finite numbers\");\n    return FLOAT_FIELDS.has(key ?? \"\") && Number.isInteger(value) ? `${value}.0` : JSON.stringify(value);\n  }\n  if (Array.isArray(value)) {\n    const items = value.map((item) => serializeJson(item, pretty, sortKeys, level + 1));\n    return pretty && items.length > 0\n      ? `[\\n${items.map((item) => `${\"  \".repeat(level + 1)}${item ?? \"null\"}`).join(\",\\n\")}\\n${\"  \".repeat(level)}]`\n      : `[${items.map((item) => item ?? \"null\").join(\",\")}]`;\n  }\n  if (typeof value === \"object\") {\n    const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;\n    const keys = Object.keys(record);\n    if (sortKeys) keys.sort();\n    const entries = keys.flatMap((entryKey) => {\n      const serialized = serializeJson(record[entryKey], pretty, sortKeys, level + 1, entryKey);\n      return serialized === undefined ? [] : [[entryKey, serialized] as const];\n    });\n    return pretty && entries.length > 0\n      ? `{\\n${entries.map(([entryKey, serialized]) => `${\"  \".repeat(level + 1)}${JSON.stringify(entryKey)}: ${serialized}`).join(\",\\n\")}\\n${\"  \".repeat(level)}}`\n      : `{${entries.map(([entryKey, serialized]) => `${JSON.stringify(entryKey)}:${serialized}`).join(\",\")}}`;\n  }\n  throw new TypeError(`Unsupported JSON value: ${typeof value}`);\n}\n\n/** Backend-compatible JSON: sorted keys and decimal spelling for float fields. */\nexport function canonicalJson(value: unknown): string {\n  return serializeJson(value, false, true) ?? \"null\";\n}\n\nexport function computeStateHash(data: unknown): string {\n  const json = typeof data === \"string\" ? data : canonicalJson(data);\n  return sha256Bytes(new TextEncoder().encode(json));\n}\n\n// ── Capture ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport interface TraceCaptureOptions {\n  episodeId?: string;\n  sessionId?: string;\n  /** Required: live gameplay, synthetic episodes and benchmark episodes must stay distinguishable. */\n  runKind: \"live\" | \"synthetic\" | \"benchmark\";\n  envVersion?: string;\n  /**\n   * Re-bases every captured event timestamp onto this instant, one\n   * `MS_PER_TICK` step per tick. Scripted exports pass it so the same played\n   * shift produces the same bytes; live capture omits it and keeps the\n   * timestamps the run actually recorded.\n   */\n  startTime?: string;\n  deletion?: Partial<TraceV3Deletion>;\n  /** Omit to capture the run's own recorded event journal; pass to replace it wholesale. */\n  events?: TraceV3Event[];\n  /**\n   * Events the caller wants merged into the captured journal alongside the\n   * game's own recorded events (e.g. an out-of-band player note). Each one is\n   * stamped with the round its `tick` falls in, so a caller cannot introduce\n   * an event the reviewer cannot line up against the round it belongs to.\n   */\n  additionalEvents?: TraceV3Event[];\n}\n\nconst RUN_KINDS: readonly TraceCaptureOptions[\"runKind\"][] = [\"live\", \"synthetic\", \"benchmark\"];\n\nfunction episodeIdFor(initialState: Record<string, unknown>, variation: string, seed: number): string {\n  const episode = initialState.episode as { id?: unknown } | undefined;\n  return typeof episode?.id === \"string\" && episode.id ? episode.id : `${variation}-${seed}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Capture a complete, replayable `restaurant-arena-trace/v3` record from a\n * running game: its tick-0 state, its event journal, and the ordered inputs\n * plus checkpoint hashes `replayArenaTrace` re-derives.\n *\n * `RestaurantGame.captureTrace` is a thin wrapper around this, so a caller that\n * holds a game and one that only holds a module import get the same record.\n */\nexport function captureArenaTrace(game: RestaurantGame, options: TraceCaptureOptions): RestaurantArenaTraceV3 {\n  if (typeof options !== \"object\" || options === null) {\n    throw new TypeError(\"captureArenaTrace requires an options object naming a runKind\");\n  }\n  if (!RUN_KINDS.includes(options.runKind)) {\n    throw new TypeError(\n      `captureArenaTrace requires runKind of ${RUN_KINDS.map((kind) => `\"${kind}\"`).join(\", \")}; received ${JSON.stringify(options.runKind)}`,\n    );\n  }\n\n  const initialState = game.getInitialState();\n  const replay = game.getReplayRecord();\n  const seed = typeof initialState.seed === \"number\" ? initialState.seed : game.state().seed;\n  const ticksPerRound = game.contract().ticksPerRound;\n\n  const journal = rebaseTimestamps(options.events ?? game.getRecordedEvents(), options.startTime);\n  const additional = (options.additionalEvents ?? []).map((event) => ({\n    ...event,\n    round: roundForTick(event.tick, ticksPerRound),\n  }));\n\n  return {\n    version: TRACE_V3_VERSION,\n    episodeId: options.episodeId ?? episodeIdFor(initialState, replay.variation, seed),\n    ...(options.sessionId !== undefined ? { sessionId: options.sessionId } : {}),\n    seed,\n    envVersion: options.envVersion ?? ARENA_ENV_VERSION,\n    contractVersion: TRACE_V3_CONTRACT_VERSION,\n    runKind: options.runKind,\n    initialState,\n    events: mergeEventsByTick(journal, additional),\n    replay,\n    terminal: game.getTerminalStatus(),\n    deletion: {\n      requestId: options.deletion?.requestId ?? null,\n      status: options.deletion?.status ?? \"retained\",\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction rebaseTimestamps(events: readonly TraceV3Event[], startTime?: string): TraceV3Event[] {\n  if (startTime === undefined) return events.map((event) => ({ ...event }));\n  const base = Date.parse(startTime);\n  if (!Number.isFinite(base)) throw new TypeError(`captureArenaTrace startTime is not a date: ${JSON.stringify(startTime)}`);\n  return events.map((event) => ({\n    ...event,\n    timestamp: new Date(base + event.tick * MS_PER_TICK).toISOString(),\n  }));\n}\n\n/**\n * Caller-supplied events land in tick order among the game's own, so the\n * journal a reviewer reads is still chronological. Stable within a tick: the\n * run's own events come first.\n */\nfunction mergeEventsByTick(journal: TraceV3Event[], additional: TraceV3Event[]): TraceV3Event[] {\n  if (additional.length === 0) return journal;\n  return [\n    ...journal.map((event) => ({ event, source: 0 })),\n    ...additional.map((event) => ({ event, source: 1 })),\n  ]\n    .sort((a, b) => a.event.tick - b.event.tick || a.source - b.source)\n    .map(({ event }) => event);\n}\n\n// ── Export ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/**\n * The whole record as one pretty-printed JSON document, in the order the record\n * declares its fields and with the backend's decimal spelling for float fields\n * (`\"cash\": 107.0`) so a consumer that types `cash` as a float decodes one.\n */\nexport function exportTraceJson(trace: RestaurantArenaTraceV3): string {\n  return `${serializeJson(trace, true, false) ?? \"null\"}\\n`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Newline-delimited streaming form: a header line carrying everything but the\n * journal, then one line per event. Re-assembling is `{ ...header, events }`.\n */\nexport function exportTraceJsonl(trace: RestaurantArenaTraceV3): string {\n  const { events, ...header } = trace;\n  const lines = [header, ...events].map((line) => serializeJson(line, false, false) ?? \"null\");\n  return `${lines.join(\"\\n\")}\\n`;\n}\n\n// ── Validation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport interface TraceValidationResult {\n  valid: boolean;\n  errors: string[];\n}\n\nconst ARENA_ID = Each one is\n   * stamped with the round its `tick` falls in, so a caller cannot introduce\n   * an event the reviewer cannot line up against the round it belongs to.\n   */\n  additionalEvents?: TraceV3Event[];\n}\n\nconst RUN_KINDS: readonly TraceCaptureOptions[\"runKind\"][] = [\"live\", \"synthetic\", \"benchmark\"];\n\nfunction episodeIdFor(initialState: Record<string, unknown>, variation: string, seed: number): string {\n  const episode = initialState.episode as { id?: unknown } | undefined;\n  return typeof episode?.id === \"string\" && episode.id ? episode.id : `${variation}-${seed}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Capture a complete, replayable `restaurant-arena-trace/v3` record from a\n * running game: its tick-0 state, its event journal, and the ordered inputs\n * plus checkpoint hashes `replayArenaTrace` re-derives.\n *\n * `RestaurantGame.captureTrace` is a thin wrapper around this, so a caller that\n * holds a game and one that only holds a module import get the same record.\n */\nexport function captureArenaTrace(game: RestaurantGame, options: TraceCaptureOptions): RestaurantArenaTraceV3 {\n  if (typeof options !== \"object\" || options === null) {\n    throw new TypeError(\"captureArenaTrace requires an options object naming a runKind\");\n  }\n  if (!RUN_KINDS.includes(options.runKind)) {\n    throw new TypeError(\n      `captureArenaTrace requires runKind of ${RUN_KINDS.map((kind) => `\"${kind}\"`).join(\", \")}; received ${JSON.stringify(options.runKind)}`,\n    );\n  }\n\n  const initialState = game.getInitialState();\n  const replay = game.getReplayRecord();\n  const seed = typeof initialState.seed === \"number\" ? initialState.seed : game.state().seed;\n  const ticksPerRound = game.contract().ticksPerRound;\n\n  const journal = rebaseTimestamps(options.events ?? game.getRecordedEvents(), options.startTime);\n  const additional = (options.additionalEvents ?? []).map((event) => ({\n    ...event,\n    round: roundForTick(event.tick, ticksPerRound),\n  }));\n\n  return {\n    version: TRACE_V3_VERSION,\n    episodeId: options.episodeId ?? episodeIdFor(initialState, replay.variation, seed),\n    ...(options.sessionId !== undefined ? { sessionId: options.sessionId } : {}),\n    seed,\n    envVersion: options.envVersion ?? ARENA_ENV_VERSION,\n    contractVersion: TRACE_V3_CONTRACT_VERSION,\n    runKind: options.runKind,\n    initialState,\n    events: mergeEventsByTick(journal, additional),\n    replay,\n    terminal: game.getTerminalStatus(),\n    deletion: {\n      requestId: options.deletion?.requestId ?? null,\n      status: options.deletion?.status ?? \"retained\",\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction rebaseTimestamps(events: readonly TraceV3Event[], startTime?: string): TraceV3Event[] {\n  if (startTime === undefined) return events.map((event) => ({ ...event }));\n  const base = Date.parse(startTime);\n  if (!Number.isFinite(base)) throw new TypeError(`captureArenaTrace startTime is not a date: ${JSON.stringify(startTime)}`);\n  return events.map((event) => ({\n    ...event,\n    timestamp: new Date(base + event.tick * MS_PER_TICK).toISOString(),\n  }));\n}\n\n/**\n * Caller-supplied events land in tick order among the game's own, so the\n * journal a reviewer reads is still chronological. Stable within a tick: the\n * run's own events come first.\n */\nfunction mergeEventsByTick(journal: TraceV3Event[], additional: TraceV3Event[]): TraceV3Event[] {\n  if (additional.length === 0) return journal;\n  return [\n    ...journal.map((event) => ({ event, source: 0 })),\n    ...additional.map((event) => ({ event, source: 1 })),\n  ]\n    .sort((a, b) => a.event.tick - b.event.tick || a.source - b.source)\n    .map(({ event }) => event);\n}\n\n// ── Export ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/**\n * The whole record as one pretty-printed JSON document, in the order the record\n * declares its fields and with the backend's decimal spelling for float fields\n * (`\"cash\": 107.0`) so a consumer that types `cash` as a float decodes one.\n */\nexport function exportTraceJson(trace: RestaurantArenaTraceV3): string {\n  return `${serializeJson(trace, true, false) ?? \"null\"}\\n`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Newline-delimited streaming form: a header line carrying everything but the\n * journal, then one line per event. Re-assembling is `{ ...header, events }`.\n */\nexport function exportTraceJsonl(trace: RestaurantArenaTraceV3): string {\n  const { events, ...header } = trace;\n  const lines = [header, ...events].map((line) => serializeJson(line, false, false) ?? \"null\");\n  return `${lines.join(\"\\n\")}\\n`;\n}\n\n// ── Validation ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport interface TraceValidationResult {\n  valid: boolean;\n  errors: string[];\n}\n\nconst ARENA_ID = /^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}[Tt]\\d{2}:\\d{2}:\\d{2}(\\.\\d+)?([Zz]|[+-]\\d{2}:\\d{2})$/;\n\nconst TRACE_EVENT_KINDS: readonly string[] = [\n  \"observation\", \"action\", \"player_correction\", \"message\", \"outcome\", \"inspection\", \"hold\",\n  \"hold_cleared\", \"verification_request\", \"verification_response\", \"escalation\", \"handoff\",\n  \"supply_order\", \"supply_delivered\", \"stockout\",\n];\n/** Includes the legacy `expediter`: historical traces named it and stay valid. */\nconst TRACE_ROLES: readonly string[] = [\"host\", \"supply_lead\", \"chef\", \"server\", \"expediter\"];\nconst VARIATIONS: readonly string[] = [\"tutorial-shift\", \"dinner-rush\", \"quiet-tuesday\", \"saturday-night\"];\nconst CORRECTION_CATEGORIES: readonly string[] = [\"safety\", \"priority\", \"quality\", \"pace\"];\nconst SUBJECT_KINDS: readonly string[] = [\"order\", \"ingredient\", \"equipment\", \"handoff\"];\nconst DELETION_STATUSES: readonly string[] = [\"retained\", \"requested\", \"deleted\"];\nconst TERMINAL_STATUSES: readonly string[] = [\"active\", \"completed\", \"abandoned\"];\n\nconst TRACE_KEYS: readonly string[] = [\n  \"version\", \"episodeId\", \"sessionId\", \"seed\", \"envVersion\", \"contractVersion\", \"runKind\",\n  \"initialState\", \"events\", \"deletion\", \"replay\", \"terminal\",\n];\nconst EVENT_KEYS: readonly string[] = [\n INPUT_REQUIRED: Record<string, readonly string[]> = {\n  step: [\"kind\", \"tick\", \"stateHash\", \"action\"],\n  time: [\"kind\", \"tick\", \"stateHash\"],\n  envelope: [\"kind\", \"tick\", \"object\" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);\n}\n\nclass FieldErrors {\n  readonly errors: string[] = [];\n\n  add(path: string, message: string): void {\n    this.errors.push(`${path}: ${message}`);\n  }\n\n  /** True when the field is present and well-formed, so callers can stop drilling. */\n  check(path: string, value: unknown, message: string, ok: (value: unknown) => boolean): boolean {\n    if (ok(value)) return true;\n    this.add(path, message);\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  required(path: string, container: Record<string, unknown>, keys: readonly string[]): void {\n    for (const key of keys) {\n      if (container[key] === undefined) this.add(`${path}${path ? \".\" : \"\"}${key}`, \"is required\");\n    }\n  }\n\n  noExtraKeys(path: string, container: Record<string, unknown>, allowed: readonly string[]): void {\n    for (const key of Object.keys(container)) {\n      if (!allowed.includes(key)) this.add(`${path}${path ? \".\" : \"\"}${key}`, \"is not a known field\");\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nconst isArenaId = (value: unknown): boolean => typeof value === \"string\" && ARENA_ID.test(value);\nconst isStateHash = (value: unknown): boolean => typeof found.required(\"\", trace, [\n    \"version\", \"episodeId\", \"seed\", \"envVersion\", \"contractVersion\", \"runKind\", \"initialState\",\n    \"events\", \"deletion\", \"replay\", \"terminal\",\n found.errors };\n}\n\nfunction validateInitialState(found: FieldErrors, value: unknown): void {\n  if (!found.check(\"initialState\", value, \"must be a JSON object\", isRecord)) return;\n  const \"equipment\", \"workers\",\n    \"emergency\", \"reputation\", \"outcomes\",\n  ]);\n  if (state.version !== undefined) {\n    found.check(\"initialState.version\", state.version, `must be \"${TRACE_V3_CONTRACT_VERSION}\"`, (v) => v === TRACE_V3_CONTRACT_VERSION);\n  }\n  if (state.seed !== undefined) found.check(\"initialState.seed\", state.seed, \"must be an integer >= 0\", isTick);\n unknown): void {\n  if (!found.check(path, value, \"must be a JSON object\", isRecord)) return;\n  const event = value as Record<string, unknown>;\n  found.required(path, event, [\"tick\", \"kind\", \"timestamp\", \"stateHash\"]);\n  found.noExtraKeys(path, event, EVENT_KEYS);\n\n  const optional: Array<[string, (v: unknown) => boolean, string]> = [\n    [\"tick\", isTick, \"must be an integer >= [\"outcome\", isNullableRecord, \"must be an object or null\"],\n    [\"payload\", isNullableRecord, \"must be an object or null\"],\n    [\"correctionRationale\", isNullableString, \"must be a string or null\"],\n    [\"correctionCategory\", (v) => v === null || CORRECTION_CATEGORIES.includes(v as string), `must be null or one of ${CORRECTION_CATEGORIES.join(\", \")}`],\n validateToolResult(found, `${path}.toolResult`, event.toolResult);\n  }\n}\n\nfunction validateToolResult(found: FieldErrors, path: string, value: unknown): void {\n  if (!found.check(path, value, found.check(`${path}.error.${key}`, body[key], \"must be a non-empty string\", (v) => typeof v === \"string\" && v.length > 0);\n        }\n      }\n      if (body.retryable !== undefined) {\n        found.check(`${path}.error.retryable`, body.retryable, \"must be a boolean\", (v) => typeof v === \"boolean\");\n      }\n    }\n    // A grader filtering on `ok` and one filtering on error presence const replay = value as Record<string, unknown>;\n  found.required(\"replay\", replay, [\"variation\", \"inputs\", \"finalStateHash\"]);\n  found.noExtraKeys(\"replay\", replay, [\"variation\", \"inputs\", \"finalStateHash\", \"finalRestaurantStateHash\"]);\n  if (replay.variation !== undefined) {\n    found.check(\"replay.variation\", replay.variation, `must be one of ${VARIATIONS.join(\", \")}`, (v) => VARIATIONS.includes(v as string));\n  }\n  if (replay.finalStateHash !== undefined) {\n    found.check(\"replay.finalStateHash\", replay.finalStateHash, `must match ${STATE_HASH.source}`, isStateHash);\n  }\n  if (replay.finalRestaurantStateHash !== undefined) {\n    found.check(\"replay.finalRestaurantStateHash\", replay.finalRestaurantStateHash, `must match ${STATE_HASH.source}`, isStateHash);\n  }\n  if (replay.inputs === undefined) return;\n  if (!found.check(\"replay.inputs\", replay.inputs, \"must be an array\", Array.isArray)) return;\n  (replay.inputs as unknown[]).forEach((input, index) => validateInput(found, `replay.inputs[${index}]`, input));\n}\n\nfunction validateInput(found: FieldErrors, path: string, value: unknown): void {\n  if (!found.check(path, value, \"must be a JSON object\", isRecord)) return;\n  const input = value as Record<string, unknown>;\n  const kind = input.kind;\n  if (typeof kind !== \"string\" || !(kind in INPUT_KEYS)) {\n    found.add(`${path}.kind`, `must be one of ${Object.keys(INPUT_KEYS).join(\", \")}`);\n    return;\n  }\n  found.required(path, input, INPUT_REQUIRED[kind]!);\n >>> 2) | (a << 30)) ^ ((a >>> 13) | (a << 19)) ^ ((a >>> 22) | (a << 10));\n      const maj = (a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c);\n      const temp2 = (s0 + maj) >>> 0;\n\n      h = g;\n      g = f;\n      f = e;\n      e = (d + temp1) >>> 0;\n      d = c;\n      c = b;\n      b = a;\n      a = (temp1 + temp2) >>> 0;\n    }\n\n    h0 = (h0 + a) >>> 0;\n    h1 = (h1 + b) >>> 0;\n    h2 = (h2 + c) >>> 0;\n    h3 = (h3 + d) >>> 0;\n    h4 = (h4 + e) >>> 0;\n    h5 = (h5 + f) >>> 0;\n    h6 = (h6 + g) >>> 0;\n    h7 = (h7 + h) >>> 0;\n  }\n\n  const hex = [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, h7]\n    .map((v) => (v >>> 0).toString(16).padStart(8, \"0\"))\n    .join(\"\");\n  return `sha256:${hex}`;\n}\n\nconst FLOAT_FIELDS = new Set([\n  \"cash\", \"coordination\", \"correctionUptake\", \"load\", \"reading\",\n  \"reputation\", \"safetyThreshold\", \"satisfaction\", \"waitTime\", \"waste\",\n]);\n\nfunction serializeJson(value: unknown, pretty: boolean, sortKeys: boolean, level = 0, key?: string): string | undefined {\n  if (value === undefined) return undefined;\n  if (value === null || typeof value === \"boolean\" || typeof value === \"string\") return JSON.stringify(value);\n  if (typeof value === \"number\") {\n    if (!Number.isFinite(value)) throw new TypeError(\"canonical JSON does not support non-finite numbers\");\n    return FLOAT_FIELDS.has(key ?? \"\") && Number.isInteger(value) ? `${value}.0` : JSON.stringify(value);\n  }\n  if (Array.isArray(value)) {\n    const items = value.map((item) => serializeJson(item, pretty, sortKeys, level + 1));\n    return pretty && items.length > 0\n      ? `[\\n${items.map((item) => `${\"  \".repeat(level + 1)}${item ?? \"null\"}`).join(\",\\n\")}\\n${\"  \".repeat(level)}]`\n      : `[${items.map((item) => item ?? \"null\").join(\",\")}]`;\n  }\n  if (typeof value === \"object\") {\n    const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;\n    const keys = Object.keys(record);\n    if (sortKeys) ? [] : [[entryKey, serialized] as const];\n    });\n    return pretty && entries.length > 0\n      ? `{\\n${entries.map(([entryKey, serialized]) => `${\"  \".repeat(level + 1)}${JSON.stringify(entryKey)}: ${serialized}`).join(\",\\n\")}\\n${\"  \".repeat(level)}}`\n      : `{${entries.map(([entryKey, serialized]) => `${JSON.stringify(entryKey)}:${serialized}`).join(\",\")}}`;\n  }\n  throw new TypeError(`Unsupported JSON value: ${typeof value}`);\n}\n\n/** Backend-compatible JSON: sorted keys and decimal spelling for float fields. */\nexport function canonicalJson(value: unknown): string {\n  return serializeJson(value, false, true) ?? \"null\";\n}\n\nexport function computeStateHash(data: unknown): string {\n  const json = typeof data === \"string\" ? data : canonicalJson(data);\n  return sha256Bytes(new TextEncoder().encode(json));\n}\n\n// ── Capture ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\nexport interface TraceCaptureOptions {\n  episodeId?: string;\n  sessionId?: string;\n  /** Required: live gameplay, synthetic episodes and benchmark episodes must stay distinguishable. */\n  runKind: \"live\" | \"synthetic\" | \"benchmark\";\n  envVersion?: string;\n  /**\n   * Re-bases every captured event timestamp onto this instant, one\n   * `MS_PER_TICK` step per tick. Each one is\n   * stamped with the round its `tick` falls in, so a caller cannot introduce\n   * an event the reviewer cannot line up against the round it belongs to.\n   */\n  additionalEvents?: TraceV3Event[];\n}\n\nconst RUN_KINDS: readonly TraceCaptureOptions[\"runKind\"][] = [\"live\", \"synthetic\", \"benchmark\"];\n\nfunction episodeIdFor(initialState: Record<string, unknown>, variation: string, seed: number): string {\n  const episode = initialState.episode as { id?: unknown } | undefined;\n  return typeof episode?.id === \"string\" && episode.id ? episode.id : `${variation}-${seed}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Capture a complete, replayable `restaurant-arena-trace/v3` record from a\n * running game: its tick-0 state, its event journal, and the ordered inputs\n * plus checkpoint hashes `replayArenaTrace` re-derives.\n *\n * `RestaurantGame.captureTrace` is a thin wrapper around this, so a caller that\n * holds a game and one that only holds a module import get the same record.\n */\nexport function captureArenaTrace(game: RestaurantGame, options: TraceCaptureOptions): RestaurantArenaTraceV3 {\n  if (typeof options !== \"object\" || options === null) {\n    throw new TypeError(\"captureArenaTrace requires an options object naming a runKind\");\n  }\n  if (!RUN_KINDS.includes(options.runKind)) {\n    throw new TypeError(\n      `captureArenaTrace requires runKind of ${RUN_KINDS.map((kind) => `\"${kind}\"`).join(\", \")}; received ${JSON.stringify(options.runKind)}`,\n    );\n  }\n\n  const initialState = game.getInitialState();\n  const replay = game.getReplayRecord();\n  const seed = typeof initialState.seed === \"number\" ? initialState.seed : game.state().seed;\n  const ticksPerRound = game.contract().ticksPerRound;\n\n  const journal = rebaseTimestamps(options.events ?? game.getRecordedEvents(), options.startTime);\n  const additional = (options.additionalEvents ?? []).map((event) => ({\n    ...event,\n    round: roundForTick(event.tick, ticksPerRound),\n  }));\n\n  return {\n    version: TRACE_V3_VERSION,\n    episodeId: options.episodeId ?? episodeIdFor(initialState, replay.variation, seed),\n    ...(options.sessionId !== undefined ? { sessionId: options.sessionId } : {}),\n    seed,\n    envVersion: options.envVersion ?? ARENA_ENV_VERSION,\n    contractVersion: TRACE_V3_CONTRACT_VERSION,\n    runKind: options.runKind,\n    initialState,\n    events: mergeEventsByTick(journal, additional),\n    replay,\n    terminal: game.getTerminalStatus(),\n    deletion: {\n      requestId: options.deletion?.requestId ?? null,\n      status: options.deletion?.status ?? \"retained\",\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction rebaseTimestamps(events: readonly TraceV3Event[], startTime?: string): TraceV3Event[] {\n  if (startTime === undefined) return events.map((event) => ({ ...event }));\n  const base = Date.parse(startTime);\n  if (!Number.isFinite(base)) throw new TypeError(`captureArenaTrace startTime is not a date: ${JSON.stringify(startTime)}`);\n  return events.map((event) => ({\n    ...event,\n    timestamp: new Date(base + event.tick * MS_PER_TICK).toISOString(),\n  }));\n}\n\n/**\n * Caller-supplied events land in tick order among the game's own, so the\n * journal a reviewer reads is still chronological. Stable within a tick: the\n * run's own events come first.\n */\nfunction mergeEventsByTick(journal: TraceV3Event[], additional: TraceV3Event[]): TraceV3Event[] {\n  if (additional.length === 0) return journal;\n  return [\n    ...journal.map((event) => ({ event, source: 0 })),\n    ...additional.map((event) => ({ event, source: 1 })),\n  ]\n    .sort((a, b) => a.event.tick - b.event.tick || a.source - b.source)\n    .map(({ event }) => event);\n}\n\n// ── Export ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n/**\n * The whole record as one pretty-printed JSON document, in the order the record\n * declares its fields and with the backend's decimal spelling for float fields\n * (`\"cash\": 107.0`) so a consumer that types `cash` as a float decodes one.\n */\nexport function exportTraceJson(trace: RestaurantArenaTraceV3): string {\n  return `${serializeJson(trace, true, false) ?? \"null\"}\\n`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Newline-delimited streaming form: a header line carrying everything but the\n * journal, then one line per event.
